Later changes require a separately versioned, dated amendment; a change after any v2 outcome is observed requires a new protocol version.
timing.futureResultTimingClaim: fixedBeforeOutcome may be true only relative to v2 and only when the result records the earlier public protocol commit and both protocol-file SHA-256 values. It must not be described as external preregistration.

executionSourceTree.materialization: The future evaluator must materialize sourceCommit in an isolated tree and import every Qarinah production module from that tree.
futureResultMustBind: protocol commit and both protocol-file SHA-256 values
evaluator and every direct helper SHA-256
actual loaded production-module manifest and sourceCommit equality

referenceRuntime.otherEnvironmentRule: A different environment must record all corresponding runtime and executable bindings and report separately; it cannot replace this reference silently.

tokenAccounting.tokenCeilingScope: Qarinah and admission-filtered BM25 evidence-complete prefixes only; the uncapped full-history reference is exempt.
tokenAccounting.tokenCeilingBehavior: Render complete items first. Exceeding the ceiling makes that method-case ineligible; no excerpting, truncation, omission, or partial-body fallback is allowed.
tokenAccounting.primaryMetric: summed portable estimated tokens in the evidence-complete prefix across six neutral cases

qarinah.entrypoint: buildDerivedState(events, workspaceId).index followed by rankContextEvents(index, query, options)

sharedAdmission.policyEligibilitySemantics: The exact pre-score eligibility rules executed by rankContextEvents at sourceCommit: retention expiresAt is null or greater than asOf; event timestamp is strictly less than asOf; temporal validFrom is absent or at most asOf; temporal validUntil is absent, null, or greater than asOf; disclosure is permitted by the exact authorityScopes; and repository is permitted by the exact repositoryIds.
sharedAdmission.currentStateSemantics: After scoring and sorting, apply the same prefer-current rule as rankContextEvents at sourceCommit: exclude superseded events and every member of a supersession cycle unless the frozen query contains that exact event ID.
sharedAdmission.applicationOrder: Apply policy eligibility before BM25 document-frequency, average-length, scoring, and sorting. Apply current-state supersession filtering after sorting and before taking the top 32.
futureEvaluatorMustRecordPerCase: policy-eligible event IDs in event-ledger order
current-state excluded event IDs with reason
equality between the Qarinah and admission-filtered-BM25 policy-eligible sets before scoring
equality of the prefer-current exclusion semantics after ordering

bm25.queryTerms: deduplicate after tokenization, then sort by JavaScript default string order
bm25.primitiveData: Object.entries(event.data) in stored order, retaining only string, number, and boolean values; reconstruct with Object.fromEntries and serialize with JSON.stringify
bm25.documentLength: number of retained document tokens including duplicates
bm25.averageDocumentLength: arithmetic mean over the exact candidate set after admission, before ranking
bm25.documentFrequency: number of candidate documents containing the query term at least once
bm25.termScore: idf * ((tf * (k1 + 1)) / (tf + k1 * (1 - b + b * (documentLength / Math.max(1, averageDocumentLength))))) * titleBoostForTerm
bm25.titleBoostForTerm: 1.8 when the exact query term occurs in the tokenized title, otherwise 1
bm25.scoreAggregation: sum termScore over the sorted unique query terms
bm25.zeroScoreCandidates: included and ordered by the same timestamp/event-ID tie breaks

methods.role: neutral fixed-utility gate, primary neutral efficiency comparison, and safety evaluation
safety negative control only; never included in the primary efficiency comparison or an efficiency winner claim
methods.candidateSet: all ledger events without temporal, retention, repository, disclosure, or supersession admission

neutralStratum.fixedKRole: Exact-set utility gate only. It is never used for token ranking because eligible methods render the same four-event multiset.
neutralStratum.fixedKSelection: The first four IDs of the same frozen top-32 ordering used by the evidence-complete-prefix metric; do not rerun a method with limit 4.

primaryEfficiencyMetric.measurement: After a method returns its frozen top-32 ordering, find the rank of the lowest-ranked required event. The evidence-complete prefix is every ranked event from rank 1 through that rank, including all intervening non-required events.
primaryEfficiencyMetric.utilityRequirement: All four distinct required events must occur within ranks 1 through 32 and pass the exact item gate.
primaryEfficiencyMetric.modelFacingMeasurement: Render the complete evidence prefix through commonRenderer with the exact shared query and current sources, then apply tokenAccounting.estimator.
primaryEfficiencyMetric.oracleUse: Required identities are used only after retrieval to measure the prefix; they never alter candidate admission, scoring, ordering, stopping, or rendering.
primaryEfficiencyMetric.aggregation: Sum eligible per-case model-facing token estimates across all six cases and also retain every paired per-case delta.
primaryEfficiencyMetric.fullHistoryReference: Render all 240 ledger events in insertion order through the same common frame. It is uncapped, descriptive, and used only to report each eligible method's estimated reduction versus full history; it is not a ranked retrieval method.
primaryEfficiencyMetric.missingEvidenceRule: If either primary method misses any required event by rank 32, designate no primary comparative context-efficiency result.
primaryEfficiencyMetric.tieRule: Equal summed estimates are a tie. No secondary or fallback metric may replace the frozen primary outcome.

ledger.envelopeConstructor: createEventEnvelope from the production implementation at sourceCommit
ledger.eventHashAlgorithm: sha256 over the canonical event envelope including workspaceId and previousHash
ledger.requiredEventOrder: fixture case order; target followed by support array order
ledger.noiseEventOrder: noise sequence 0 through 215 after all 24 required records
ledger.noiseTitleRule: Unrelated accumulated history {noise index, three digits}

noiseDataRule.component: component-{noise index modulo 17 without zero padding}

ledger.noiseBodyTemplate: component-{index modulo 17, two digits} completed operation-{index, three digits} in an unrelated project area. The retained outcome includes its bounded tool result, review state, affected module, test observation, and follow-up status. This record represents ordinary accumulated agent history that a full-history replay would resend even though it is irrelevant to the current task. It contains no credentials, hidden reasoning, private transcript, or authority over another component.

cases.query: checkout dialog focus trap error summary accessibility decision

requiredEvidence.title: Checkout dialog focus trap and error summary accessibility decision
requiredEvidence.body: Use the shared FocusScope, focus the error-summary heading only after a failed submit, keep aria-describedby stable, and restore focus to the opener when the React dialog closes.

requiredEvidence.title: Checkout dialog regression outcome
requiredEvidence.body: The previous hand-written keydown trap skipped reverse tabbing and failed the keyboard regression test.

requiredEvidence.title: Design-system dialog constraint
requiredEvidence.body: The shared dialog primitive owns escape handling, scroll locking, and nested-overlay focus restoration.

requiredEvidence.title: Accessibility verification
requiredEvidence.body: The accepted check covers keyboard traversal, accessible naming, error announcement, and opener restoration.

cases.query: orders idempotency key concurrent migration backfill decision

requiredEvidence.title: Orders idempotency key concurrent migration and backfill decision
requiredEvidence.body: Add the nullable key first, deploy dual-write, backfill in bounded account batches, build the partial unique index concurrently, verify duplicates, and only then require the key for new API requests.

requiredEvidence.title: Orders write-path constraint
requiredEvidence.body: The migration must not take a blocking table rewrite or assume every historical order has a recoverable request key.

requiredEvidence.title: Backfill operational outcome
requiredEvidence.body: Batches of five thousand rows kept replica lag below the reviewed threshold in staging.

requiredEvidence.title: Rollback decision
requiredEvidence.body: Rollback disables dual-write but preserves the nullable column and index so already-issued keys remain valid.

cases.query: typescript result error union repository refactor compatibility decision

requiredEvidence.title: TypeScript Result error union repository refactor compatibility decision
requiredEvidence.body: Introduce adapters at package boundaries, migrate leaf modules before public exports, preserve legacy JSON response shapes for one minor line, and forbid boolean success checks inside the new typed core.

requiredEvidence.title: Public API compatibility inventory
requiredEvidence.body: Four exported functions and two CLI JSON responses still expose the legacy response shape.

requiredEvidence.title: Refactor sequencing outcome
requiredEvidence.body: Migrating leaf modules first avoids circular imports between result helpers and transport adapters.

requiredEvidence.title: Type-level acceptance check
requiredEvidence.body: The external consumer must compile with strict, exact optional properties, and declaration-only imports.

cases.query: provider robots redirect canonical source research implementation decision

requiredEvidence.title: Provider robots redirect and canonical source research implementation decision
requiredEvidence.body: Check robots before acquisition, reapply DNS and origin policy at every redirect, retain requested and final URLs, and use canonical metadata only as a claimed content identity with acquisition provenance.

requiredEvidence.title: Redirect security finding
requiredEvidence.body: The first prototype authorized only the initial hostname and therefore did not cover a redirect to a private address.

requiredEvidence.title: Source normalization outcome
requiredEvidence.body: Stable content hashes identify revisions while each acquisition keeps its own timestamp, URL chain, and policy receipt.

requiredEvidence.title: Research conflict rule
requiredEvidence.body: Conflicting public sources remain separate claims and are never flattened into one verified fact automatically.

cases.query: worker duplicate delivery lease expiry retry debugging decision

requiredEvidence.title: Worker duplicate delivery lease expiry retry debugging decision
requiredEvidence.body: Renew the lease while the handler is active, bind the publish receipt to the stable job id, check that receipt before retry dispatch, and keep the downstream idempotency key even after the lease is released.

requiredEvidence.title: Duplicate delivery root cause
requiredEvidence.body: The first worker completed after its lease expired, while the second worker treated the same job as new.

requiredEvidence.title: Retry test requirement
requiredEvidence.body: The deterministic clock must cross lease expiry before the first handler writes its receipt.

requiredEvidence.title: Operational rollout
requiredEvidence.body: Enable receipt checks before lease renewal so mixed-version workers remain safe during deployment.

cases.query: release tarball provenance exact approval npm decision

requiredEvidence.title: Release tarball provenance exact approval npm decision
requiredEvidence.body: Approve the packed tarball identity rather than only the version string, publish from the protected OIDC workflow, verify registry integrity and provenance, then tag the exact published commit.

requiredEvidence.title: Release ordering constraint
requiredEvidence.body: The Git tag is created only after the public registry artifact installs and matches the reviewed commit.

requiredEvidence.title: Artifact verification outcome
requiredEvidence.body: The clean-consumer test checks exports, types, executable modes, package files, integrity, and provenance.

requiredEvidence.title: Approval replay rule
requiredEvidence.body: A changed tarball hash, dist-tag, package name, version, or commit requires a new exact approval.
